change.title: Remove the dormant start_proxy invoke and extract a typed GatewayController receipt
change.summary: Removes the registered start_proxy Tauri surface with no bundled caller while retaining the formal Gateway start/reuse core behind GatewayController. Successful internal calls now return a process-local typed GatewayReceipt binding route, start/reuse action, accepted health identity, catalog fingerprint, and the complete effective Science launch recipe. Existing cold, healthy, profile-switch, and recovery callers retain their lease, ordering, checkpoint, compensation, binding, journal, DTO, and visible-text ownership.

basis: the dormant registered start_proxy command and command wrapper are absent from the Tauri invoke surface while the internal formal Gateway lifecycle remains reachable only through existing product operations

GatewayController returns a non-serializable GatewayReceipt only after reuse or spawn identity, health, and catalog acceptance and binds the exact effective Science launch recipe used for fingerprinting and child environment
remembered healthy Science context is now preserved in the in-memory recipe used by AppState and compensation instead of being omitted when the caller passed no explicit runtime
cold, healthy, profile-switch, recovery, binding, journal, compensation, DTO, text, and interrupted-orphan recovery policy remain owned by their existing callers
the exact candidate 15-suite source gate and clean-context completion review remain pending, so this record does not yet claim S6 DONE
S7 coordinator slicing, PriorStopIntent or Outcome, new durable Gateway journal semantics, artifact, installed, live, signing, and release validation are excluded
